_comments: The builder's editable tree, declared as owned collections so a structural edit (add, delete,
reorder) saves through the Form root as ONE MJ.SaveEntityGraph transaction instead of a loop of
individual Save()/Delete() calls with no rollback (#103, #303). Reused from closed PR #112, which
declared Pages, Questions and Options; #303 adds Screens and makes all four Load immediate.
Load 'immediate' populates the collection in BaseEntity.Load() ONLY, never in LoadFromData(), and a
collection's own Load() materialises its children through RunView, i.e. LoadFromData. So Form.Load()
fills Pages and Screens, but each loaded page's Questions (and each question's Options) are NOT
filled by that cascade; a reader of the whole tree loads them explicitly or batches them with
RunView's IncludeRelatedRecords (one WHERE fk IN (...) per level).
Source/ReadOnly are stated explicitly rather than left to default, following MJ core's writable
collections: in a catalog of cache-backed read-only projections, an implicit writable one reads
as an oversight.
Sequence.From is 0, NOT the default 1: every DisplayOrder already stored is zero-based, and
From: 1 would mark every page, question and option in every form dirty on the first reorder.
RelatedEntity and RelatedEntityJoinField are deliberately absent from the JSON: they are read
from this row's own columns. The lookup carries RelatedEntityJoinField because
MJ_BizApps_Forms: Forms has relationships to BOTH Form Pages and Form Questions on FormID, and the
join field is what keeps them apart.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Forms&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Pages&RelatedEntityJoinField=FormID

_comments: No Sequence policy. Screen DisplayOrder is numbered WITHIN a ScreenType (the builder writes the
count of existing screens of the same type), so one sequence across the Welcome and Ending rows
would renumber both together and change what 'first ending' means.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Forms&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Screens&RelatedEntityJoinField=FormID

_comments: Joined on PageID, not FormID. FormQuestion carries BOTH keys, and MJ metadata has a
'Forms -> Form Questions' relationship on FormID as well: declaring the collection there would
put every question in the form on every page.
READ-SAFE, CREATE-UNSAFE. A collection's Create()/Add() stamps the JOIN FIELD and nothing else,
so a question created through page.Questions gets PageID and NOT FormID, which is NOT NULL and
derived by no hook. The caller must set FormID itself. PageID is also NULLABLE: a question can
belong to a form and to no page, so this collection is a partial view of the form's questions.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Pages&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Questions&RelatedEntityJoinField=PageID
